description: This Java class 'CommandResponse' is a wrapper for device response messages in an Eclipse Hono client, providing methods to create and interpret command response messages, including parsing request IDs and AMQP messages.

classes.name: CommandResponse
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates a device's response to a command, providing static factory methods to create instances from request IDs or AMQP messages, and methods to access response details.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CommandResponse instance from a request ID, tenant ID, device ID, payload, content type, and status code, parsing the request ID to extract reply-to information.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a CommandResponse instance from an AMQP message, extracting correlation ID, status, and reply-to information from the message.

methods.name: getReplyToId
methods.description: Returns the reply-to identifier extracted from the request ID.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code indicating the outcome of the command.

methods.name: toMessage
methods.description: Returns the underlying AMQP message representing this command response.

methods.name: isReplyToLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Indicates whether the response was directed at the legacy control endpoint.
